systems.country_label: National Identity Cards; NINs; mass enrolment and renewal
systems.tiers: district registration offices; mass enrolment planned across 10,717 parishes, 2,190 sub-counties and 146 districts

note: No system for births or deaths is named or described, so no fact. It does give the count of offices of the body that registers them: NIRA present in 112 districts with 24 districts and 10 cities unserved (its director, 1 July 2024), and offices in 111 of 146 districts as of October 2023 (Auditor General), with 410 of 856 posts filled; rural offices served 60 to 150 people a day against 600 to 1,000 in Kampala.
